name: Archon of Chayula
description: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.

stats.text: Requires 100 Glory to use
Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for this Skill on dealing Chaos Hit damage to an enemy or inflicting a Chaos damage over time Debuff on an enemy
Trigger Chayula's Will every 3 seconds
Grants 20% more Physical and Chaos damage
Grants 25% chance to Wither enemies for 4 seconds on Hit
